title: Measure aggregation multiple ways
question: Do the S03 aggregation findings persist under distinct, explicitly conditioned spatial summaries rather than depending on the paper's adjacency denominator alone?

population.grid: 101 floor-indexed points over accepted-swap progress, identical to S01-S03
population.pairing: preserve S03 base-draw and pairing-block construction

labelAndEdgeConventions.label: cell policy (Bubble, Insertion, or Selection)
labelAndEdgeConventions.edgeSet: the n-1 unordered adjacent position pairs (i-1,i), i=1,...,n-1
labelAndEdgeConventions.compositionConditioning: exact fixed global policy counts unless explicitly marked value-conditioned
labelAndEdgeConventions.undefinedEncoding: IEEE NaN in tables and null in JSON
labelAndEdgeConventions.trajectoryIndexing: floor(progress * final accepted swaps) for progress 0.00,...,1.00

metrics.definition: C=sum over open-path edges of 1(equal policy); publication aggregation=C/n; edge aggregation=C/(n-1)
metrics.baseline: publication: sum_k n_k(n_k-1)/n^2; edge: sum_k n_k(n_k-1)/(n(n-1))
metrics.primaryReportedForm: publication corrected excess = C/n minus its exact fixed-composition expectation
metrics.range: raw publication [0,(n-1)/n]; corrected range depends on composition

metrics.definition: Each undirected edge contributes both orientations. With observed same-edge rate o=C/(n-1), endpoint-stub label fractions a_k=s_k/[2(n-1)], and chance c=sum_k a_k^2, r=(o-c)/(1-c).
metrics.conditioning: degree-weighted endpoint marginals of the observed open path

metrics.definition: A run is a maximal contiguous constant-policy block; R is run count and mean run length is n/R.
metrics.note: On an open path R=n-C, so this family is an exact monotone restatement of adjacency and is excluded from independent-robustness counting.

metrics.definition: L is the longest constant-policy run; L_k is the longest run for policy k.
metrics.range: [1/max_k n_k,1] for capture where all labels have positive counts; [1/n,1] for array fraction

metrics.definition: Each undirected edge contributes both directions to a 2(n-1) joint table; MI=sum p_kl log2[p_kl/(a_k a_l)], entropy H=-sum a_k log2(a_k), and NMI=MI/H.
metrics.primaryReportedForm: signed_neighbor_nmi=sign(categorical assortativity)*NMI, with sign 0 when assortativity is numerically zero
metrics.note: Unsigned MI detects dependence including alternation; the signed companion distinguishes homotypic clustering from heterotypic alternation.

metrics.definition: Restrict to adjacent edges whose two values are equal. If E_v is the number of such edges and C_v the subset also equal in policy, raw=C_v/E_v.
metrics.baseline: For each value stratum v, q_v=sum_k n_vk(n_vk-1)/[n_v(n_v-1)]. With e_v observed equal-value edges in that stratum, baseline=sum_v e_v q_v/E_v.
metrics.undefined: E_v=0; this is structurally true for the unique-value input
metrics.conditioning: exact fixed policy counts within each value stratum, while retaining the observed equal-value edge allocation across strata

randomLabelCalibration.duplicateProfiles: n=20 and n=100, grouped/interleaved value layouts, with balanced and heterogeneous fixed within-value label counts
randomLabelCalibration.adjacencyPassRule: absolute corrected mean <= max(5 Monte Carlo SE, 0.001)
randomLabelCalibration.equalValuePassRule: absolute conditioned-corrected mean <= max(5 Monte Carlo SE, 0.001)
randomLabelCalibration.otherMetrics: report finite-size and composition-dependent means, quantiles, undefined rates, and bounds; zero is not assumed

validation.populationReplay: every scenario ID, scenario JSON hash, terminal, accepted-swap count, final-state hash, and original-adjacency trajectory hash must match validated S03

inference.associationAnchors: positive and negative versus absent at each input, each pairwise 50/50 policy set, and balanced three-way composition (16 paired contrasts)
inference.compositionAudit: 10/90 and 90/10 versus 50/50 under absent correlation (12 paired contrasts), descriptive because alternate metrics have deliberately different composition scaling
excludedFromIndependentCount: unsigned neighbor MI (does not encode clustering direction)
inference.familywiseIntervals: Bonferroni 95% family coverage separately over 16 association contrasts for each metric
inference.correlations: Spearman and Kendall rank correlations on 186 condition-level final means and AUCs; pairwise complete observations
inference.disagreement: sign, rank-quartile, and adjusted-contrast disagreements are reported rather than discarded

successCriteria.execution: all 46,500 scenarios and 4,696,500 grid rows validate against S03
successCriteria.calibration: all adjacency and estimable equal-value corrected random-label calibrations pass their frozen tolerance
successCriteria.associationRobustness: at least 12 of 16 association anchors have a Bonferroni lower confidence bound above zero for at least two of the three independent directional metrics
successCriteria.rankRobustness: corrected original-adjacency final condition means have Spearman rho >=0.70 with at least two of the three independent directional metrics
successCriteria.classification: supportive if all four clauses pass; constraining/contradictory if execution/calibration pass but either robustness clause fails; null if execution is valid but no usable alternate signal is found

claimBoundary: All measures are computational summaries of simulated one-dimensional policy-label arrangements. They do not establish biological aggregation, affinity, causality, intention, or attractors. Static random-label calibration is not a dynamic peak null.
